source: dbl-avocat (document Grok complet, maquette absente de la bibliothèque des sections ; chemises kraft, plumes, salle de consultation, couloir de palais générique), oppenheimer et brice-bourdon (cabinets sans patient) ; règle de la skill sur le secret professionnel.
style: Editorial still-life photography for an independent law office, {ambiance} mood, palette of {palette}, {lumiere}, tactile {matieres}, set in {lieu} on {saison}, gentle long shadows, shallow depth of field, 50mm lens, subtle film grain, serious and reassuring, modern and uncluttered.
interdits: No readable writing, no case file name, no gavel, no scales of justice, no flags or national symbols, no lawyer's robe on a person, no courtroom presented as real, no recognizable face.
evite: Évite les clichés (marteau, balance, drapeau) et toute information confidentielle lisible : chemises kraft, plumes et documents aux lignes abstraites.

404.consigne: An empty open kraft cardboard folder on a wooden desk with a single paper clip and nothing inside, soft lamp light, a slightly melancholic but gentle mood.

ouverture.consigne: A wide wooden table by a tall window at dawn with {sujet}, neatly stacked papers with blank illegible forms and abstract round ink stamps that cannot be read, a fountain pen, a softly blurred street through the window.

section-fond.consigne: A tall stack of kraft cardboard folders with coloured tabs on a dark wooden shelf, dramatic raking lamp light from the left, deep shadows, no labels.
section-fond.evite: Les étiquettes de dossiers lisibles (secret professionnel).

scene-metier.consigne: Top-down view of {sujet} on a dark wooden desk, a fountain pen with its cap off, the edge of a closed laptop and a cup of black coffee, ordered, precise composition, nothing readable.
scene-metier.source: dbl-avocat (contrat relié, plan, contrat de travail)
scene-metier.evite: La signature et le nom des parties.

lieu.consigne: A quiet consultation room with two upholstered chairs facing each other across a wooden desk, a bookshelf of bound volumes with blank spines, soft morning light through a tall window, nobody in the room.

texture.consigne: Macro photograph of ivory cotton paper, fibres and subtle grain visible, perfectly even soft lighting with no vignette and no shadows, seamless texture filling the whole frame.

portrait-generique.consigne: Close-up of an anonymous hand, seen from above with no face visible, annotating documents with a pencil, paper clips and a ruler nearby, the writing blurred and unreadable.
portrait-generique.evite: Le visage de l'avocat, qui vient de ses vraies photos.
